items.title: Chip Stocks Deepen Losses as Concerns Mount Over Rates, AI Debt
items.summary: A rout in global technology hardware stocks extended Thursday, as Asian chipmakers followed US peers lower on worries over Federal Reserve interest rate hikes and AI funding difficulties.

items.title: Nasdaq tumbles as inflation fuels rate-hike fears
items.summary: Hotter-than-expected inflation data sent the Nasdaq to a sharply lower close on Wednesday, with worries about more interest rate hikes from the Federal Reserve pummeling shares of Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sensitive to higher borrowing costs.
